info.title: SaaS Auth API
info.description: Auth service contract: machine and user APIs for identity, tenants, memberships, invitations, roles and session revocation. Identity provider: Keycloak; business authorization owned by Auth. Portal BFF and production deployment require separate integration.

get.description: Authenticated human user. Return no tenants when membership is empty; use listTenants for pagination.
get.x-authorization-policy: Authenticated human user. Return no tenants when membership is empty; use listTenants for pagination.

lifecycleSequence.description: Last tenant lifecycle event sequence; independent of authorizationVersion.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: ETag from the last resource representation; checked transactionally.

userAccess.description: Keycloak user access token; audience saas-auth, approved azp; human subject mapped through issuer+subject. Session revocation checked by Auth.

serviceAccess.description: Keycloak client_credentials token; audience saas-auth; explicit client allowlist/scopes; cannot impersonate a human.

Error.description: Stable error code; no credentials or sensitive identifiers in message.

Retry-After.description: Seconds; on rate limiting or transient dependency failure.
